description: This Java source file defines the ClientAndServer class, which extends MockServerClient and provides methods to start, stop, and manage a mock server instance, including UI interactions and listener registration.

classes.name: ClientAndServer
classes.description: A class that manages a mock server instance, allowing starting, stopping, UI management, and listener registration.

methods.name: startClientAndServer
methods.description: Static methods to instantiate and start a ClientAndServer with various configurations.

methods.name: completePortFutureAndOpenUI
methods.description: Completes the port future and optionally opens the UI if debug level is enabled.

methods.name: openUI
methods.description: Launches the UI for the mock server, with optional wait time.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the mock server is currently running.

methods.name: hasStarted
methods.description: Alias for isRunning, indicating if the server has started.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the local port of the mock server.

methods.name: getLocalPort
methods.description: Returns the local port of the mock server.

methods.name: getLocalPorts
methods.description: Returns a list of local ports used by the mock server.

methods.name: getRemoteAddress
methods.description: Returns the remote address of the mock server.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an ExpectationsListener with the mock server.
